query: Забирай файлы из S3 бакета raw-data, при необходимости распаковывай их и складывай в HDFS в каталог /data/raw.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: s3_to_hdfs_ingestion
  name: S3 to HDFS Ingestion
  description: Ingest files from S3 bucket raw-data, decompress if necessary, and
    store in HDFS /data/raw
triggers:
- id: trigger_s3_poll
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_s3
  name: Read from S3 bucket raw-data
  type: S3
  location: raw-data
  connection:
    properties:
      aws_access_key_id: '{{AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}}'
      aws_secret_access_key: '{{AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}}'
      region: '{{AWS_REGION}}'
      endpoint_url: '{{S3_ENDPOINT_URL}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_unpack
  name: Unpack if compressed
  operation: Decompress
  config:
    auto_detect: true
sinks:
- id: sink_hdfs
  name: Write to HDFS
  type: HDFS
  location: /data/raw
  connection:
    properties:
      namenode: '{{HDFS_NAMENODE}}'
      user: '{{HDFS_USER}}'
      fs.defaultFS: '{{HDFS_DEFAULT_FS}}'
processed_data:
- id: raw_files
  format: binary
links:
- from_id: source_s3
  to_id: process_unpack
  data_ref: raw_files
- from_id: process_unpack
  to_id: sink_hdfs
  data_ref: raw_files
